what_i_see: Compact spiral/disturbed galaxy with bright core and a long, thin, straight tail extending ~5" to the NNE. The tail looks redder/orange than the bluish-white disc in the colour panel.
most_likely: A one-sided tidal tail of a z~0.4 galaxy, or an edge-on background galaxy projected onto its outskirts.
against_it: The colour difference argues for a projection over a tidal tail; neither is unusual.
decisive_test: Spectroscopy or photo-z of the tail separately from the disc: different redshift means projection.
catalogue_notes: Legacy DR8 photo-z EXP z=0.37+/-0.12 at 0.75". No SIMBAD/Gaia within 30"; nearest NED WISE source ~22". No match in Jacobs+2019, Huang+2020/2021 (cone 10"; Rojas+2022 query unvalidated).
